class.name: NetwControlRequest
class.brief_description: One peer's bid to steer an entity, and the latch any listener rejects it with.
class.description: [NetwEntity] emits [signal NetwEntity.control_requested] with one [NetwControlRequest] per request. Gameplay code may inspect [member requester] and call [method deny] before the default grant path runs. Every listener sees the same record, so [member denied] is a latch: once a listener rejects, no listener after it can take the rejection back, and listener order does not decide who gets to steer. [codeblock] func _on_control_requested(peer_id: int, request: NetwControlRequest) -> void: if not can_carry(peer_id): request.deny() [/codeblock]

members.member: Whether the request should be rejected. Writing [code]false[/code] over a rejection does nothing, because the rejection is a latch.
